title: SvcCatalogCategoryItem - Data API
description: Represents an association between a Service Catalog item and category. Service catalog items can be grouped into categories. This object is available in API version 58.0 and later.

IsPrimaryCategory.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsPrimaryCategory.description: Specifies whether the category is the primary category for a catalog item. The default value is false.

SortOrder.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SortOrder.description: Controls the order in which catalog items appear by default when you're viewing all items in a single category.

SvcCatalogCategoryId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SvcCatalogCategoryId.description: ID of the category for which the service category item belongs. This field is a relationship field.

SvcCatalogItemDefId.description: ID of the service category item definition. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To access this object, get the Service Catalog Access permission set license, Employee Productivity Starter license, or Employee Productivity Plus add-on license.
